title: Home Not Alone 4
overview: In a large shopping mall, a gang of crooks—led by a cunning nanny—hatches a daring new heist. Their target: a massive prize fund. The mall’s security team is headed by some familiar faces, but they prove all too easily outwitted by the criminals. While Glent and Kobyakov keep the children entertained with fun challenges, it falls to Masha and her friends—who have thwarted such schemes three times before—to uncover the plot and stop the robbers.

title: На деревню дедушке 3. В гости к бабушке
overview: Vladik and his grandfathers settle in a seaside village, in a small house rented out by Baba Nina and her granddaughter, Masha. The boy must navigate the transition from actual war to a truce, while also experiencing his first taste of love. Meanwhile, his grandfathers find themselves at odds once again—this time, competing for Baba Nina’s attention.

title: Dudley & the Invasion of the Space Slugs
overview: Dudley is a teenage frog who lives a peaceful life by the edge of his pond with his friends, meanwhile his parents are worried about his future. But when aliens land on Earth, Dudley's world is thrown into chaos. What if he has what it takes to become a hero and save the whole of humanity?
